title: 云依助手 0.13.10
releaseNotes: Redesigned MQTT around a tall message list with payload previews, topic/content and direction filters, side-by-side details and stable history browsing. Improved Modbus data filtering, same-request change highlights and preserved results during refresh; raw frames now collapse by default. Preserves write confirmations and TLS validation. Isolates MQTT history on reconnect and protects current state from late polls. Validated responsive layouts, large message/result sets and native loopback regressions.
